column1: # B990 live ledger census (x86, eqemu lane 3, scripts/client_ledger_capture.sh,
# mode audio, WILLEQ_LEDGER_OWNERS=audio, WILLEQ_LEDGER_IDLE_EVERY=10, music
# started at zone-in then stopped by /sound off ~18 s BEFORE steady_60s).
# run      = which run's client.log the row was taken from
# baseline = B990-live rows: music STARTED then STOPPED (the card's point);
#            B977-base: the B977 census run, music STILL PLAYING at steady_60s
#            (its tour held to ~75 s, no stop) -- the 24 MB resident defect.
# live     = au.soundfont_custom live bytes at the named point
# peak     = category audio live/peak at the named point (audio category, the
#            budgeted row -- the custom font's 24 MB lived in it while resident)
# B990-live velketor peak (28,850,592) proves the font loaded in that run
# (loaded 22:20:55.155, released 22:21:31.772); at steady_60s the live row is
# the residual 2,976 B / 32 blocks -- NOT selectSoundFont bookkeeping but the
# FIRST-CALL CONSTRUCTION of getSoundFontTypeForFile()'s function-local
# `static const std::unordered_set<std::string> synthus2Files`
# (audio_manager.cpp, 31 Velious/Luclin names = 31 node blocks + 1 bucket
# array), charged to the au.soundfont_custom owner scope that playMusic wraps
# around it. B1014 CONFIRMED it by measurement: the first call's allocation
# is exactly 2,976 B / 32 blocks
# (tests/test_soundfont_release.cpp,
# SoundFontCustomScopeFirstCallIsTheSynthus2NameSet; refactor/B1014/README.md).
# The same 2,976/32 in the GM-only qeynos2 legs is the same static, first
# built by that run's first playMusic -- identical with/without the custom
# font, which is why the GM-only control shows it too.
# zone          run         point      au.soundfont_custom_live  custom_blocks  audio_live  audio_peak
velketor        B990-live   steady_60s 2976                        32             4386288     28850592
